entities.summary: Rafi Usmani was a Pakistani Islamic scholar who served as the president of Darul Uloom Karachi. He was an alumnus of Darul Uloom Deoband, University of the Punjab and the Darul Uloom Karachi, and was the elder brother of Taqi Usmani.
